title: VooPoo Uforce-X Nano Vape Tank
description: The Voopoo UForce-X Nano Tank is a high-performance sub-ohm tank engineered to deliver outstanding flavour and dense vapour production. Designed with both direct-to-lung (DTL) and restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) vaping styles in mind, this compact and versatile tank pairs seamlessly with the Voopoo Vinci Spark 100 Box Mod and is compatible with Voopoo’s renowned PnP X coils. Constructed from premium materials for durability, the UForce-X Nano Tank features an innovative adjustable top airflow system that allows you to tailor your draw to your exact preferences. Whether you prefer an airy, cloud-filled inhale or a tighter, more flavour-focused draw, this tank adapts effortlessly. The UForce-X Nano Tank also boasts a convenient top-fill design for mess-free refills, making it ideal for vapers on the go. Its leak-resistant construction ensures you can enjoy uninterrupted vaping with your favourite high-VG e-liquids, including shortfills, while the PnP X coils deliver exceptional performance with both flavour and vapour. Combining ease of use, customisability, and premium performance, the Voopoo UForce-X Nano Tank is a fantastic choice for vapers seeking a top-tier sub-ohm tank that excels in flavour, clouds, and reliability. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
